## Problem and evidence

Describe the concrete limitation and link the relevant source or issue.
Remove API keys, authenticated URLs, private paths and personal data.

## Proposed scope

Describe the intended behavior, affected files and consumers.
Identify any required maintainer decision before implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

List observable results and the isolated inputs needed to verify them.

## Validation and limits

Describe the checks needed and any unavailable host or service dependency.
Distinguish source declarations from executed compatibility results.
